notes.title: TY2 Update in Open Beta - New content!
notes.content:
Hi all!

Struth! A new TY2 build, chockers with goodies!

How do you get it?

 Quit and relaunch Steam to make sure you get the lastest build data
 Right click on the game in your library and select "Properties"
 Change to the "Betas" tab
 And select "experimental" from the drop down! (no password required)


Why Open Beta?

 There are a LOT of changes and we want to make sure that things work well across a variety of different hardware configurations
 So we'd love for people to give it a fair shake of the sauce bottle, and let us know any issues in the Bug Sub Forum
 Please see the pinned "Sending Krome Studios pub reports" post for details on what we'd like if you hit an issue


So What's Been Added?
TWO new boomerangs

The Craftyrang
Hand-crafted by Shiela's advanced pre-school class from the finest repurposed wood remnants. It has a hair trigger and really packs a wallop.
[previewyoutube=HKqL_Xgt5cI;full][/previewyoutube]

The Camerarang
*click* Looking great! *click* You're a (Tasmanian) tiger, baby! Yeah! *click*
Bush Rescue HQ has prepared a new Rang for TY, perfectly crafted to capture the moment.
Introducing the Camerang! (cue the video...)
[previewyoutube=fsTQAiD-fw8;full][/previewyoutube]

Camerang Features
Combat

 Stun those pesky Frills by throwing the Camerang toward them, generating bombarding camera flashes.

Camera Mode

 Of course, you could use the Camerang for how it's intended... taking photos!
 Pause the action to line up the perfect shot - adjusting angle, zoom and much more.
 Apply filters such as; Blur, Toon or Pixelate.
 Strike a pose by switching to Selfie Mode, presenting multiple pose options for TY.

Once you get your hands on this rang, be sure to share your masterpieces with your friends!

More Skins!

 three new TY skins and three new fourbie skins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28002635/d338e5af0611dd60d52fde00e6149c0ed845f3bb.png

Updated Infrarang FX

 We've updated the effects on the infrarang, for your visual enjoyment, to be like the upgraded visuals that we added to TY1HD


We hope you enjoy these updates and can help us by sending through details on any issues that occur, so we can do the full release early in 2022!

====================
Australian to Understandable English Rosetta Stone

 ripsnorter = something extraordinary

notes.title: TY2 Build v1.09 (r3821) Has Been Released (Misc bug fix build)
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've released a new patch for TY2, which is a miscellaneous bug fix build.
Changes in this version are as per the below.

If there are any problems, please let us know.

Cheers
Linds

Art
Small fix for clamping of UI art in shops.

Audio
Small tweaks to volumes of NPC lasers.
Reduced the volume of the enemy drop ship engines slightly to help reduce audio clutter in the first level.

Camera
Fix for camera popping out of water when TY gets hurt or does a claim (picks up a collectable) underwater.
Fix for a camera-getting-stuck issue.

Controls
Reset to Default no longer removes bindings for non-rebindable keys.
Don't require the player to neutralise the input when changing to first person view camera before it will begin responding to input.
Updated mouse aiming for rang throwing with fixes so that rangs don't throw into the ground when the camera is pointed at the ground (eg, normal third person gameplay).

Crash Fixes
Fix issue with game props that could cause an endless loop issue and potential crash when a level is streaming.

Massive Level Design Changes With Impacts Beyond the Realms of Space and Time
Removed duplicate Naomi from Burramudgee.

Save Games
Fixed issue with loading an original save game (from a very early build when the game was in Early Access) not loading correctly with latest code.

UI
Wiggle controls (eg to shake off Frills attached to Bunyips) string updated to handle gamepad and keyboard controls.
Bunyip Mortar control instructions now gives the correct controls for all languages. (Left/right stick were swapped, and no mention of Right Trigger to fire, in non-English languages).
Fixed subtitles for non-English languages, that had broken button icons displayed
Fixed the text that is displayed when the game cannot find a TY2 save game
Fix for dunny not animating when playing all tracks or random tracks (ie, multiple races without returning to frontend between).
On the rang hud, hide the "what direction is the gamepad stick being held" UI graphic element, when the sticks are not being used.

notes.title: TY2 Build r3499_v108 Released - Hardcore Mode! And, TY3 now in Early Access
notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build of TY2 (r3499_v108) has been released.
The major addition to this build is the new Hardcore Mode!

http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2_Hardcore_banner.png

In Hardcore mode we've removed all bonus lives and respawning - you literally have  life to get through the game. If you do happen to lose a life; we helpfully reset your save game and restart your adventure.

We've added two new leaderboards (Hardcore Game Complete and Hardcore 100% Game Complete) and two new achievements (Completing the game in Hardcore and 100% Completing the Game in Hardcore) for your troubles!

We hope that this provides a little bit of replayability for you all (and maybe bragging rights!). And cheats are disabled in Hardcore mode :)

http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2_Hardcore.gif

Additionally, we're happy to announce that TY3 has been released in to Early Access! As part of TY3's release, TY1 is currently on sale to celebrate; and if you own TY1 or TY2, you should receive an extra bonus discount for buying TY3 during this first week of Early Access - as we've increased the launch discount to 22% across the board!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/411980/TY_the_Tasmanian_Tiger_3/

Lastly, the following bug fixes are also in this new TY2 build:
ART: Made grill texture in the Never Never doublesided, so it draws correctly from both directions.
ART: clamped edge pixels of the mouse icons to stop icon corruption
ART: Increased the number of maximum explosions that can render at once
ART: Disabled timed-bonus Christmas skin costume
ART: Re-added support for grass overlays
CART RACING: Tweaked the difficulty of the AI to try to ensure people don't get stuck losing races, forever.
CONTROLS: Fixed a force clamping bug where large movement forces can change your direction when only one axis is clamped.
CONTROLS: Fixed support for sneaking when using KB&M (SHIFT key by default)
GAMEPLAY: Fixed the "react to bunyip punches only" flag, so that [spoiler] the vehicles blocking the A-path in the first level can't be blown up by rangs, causing a non-progression issue[/spoiler]
MISC: Crash fixes for various thread-safe issues
MISC: Prevent mouse from changing button selection or clicking on buttons while rebinding an action to fix a crash.
RANGS: Fixes to the doomerang controls
UI: Moved some overlapping arrow buttons to lessen sound spamming when moving around them with the mouse.

Cheers
Linds

notes.title: TY2 Exiting Early Access Information + build r3040_v082 released to EXPERIMENTAL
notes.content:
Hey all,

We have some exciting news for you all!
Unless there is an unexpected problem, TY the Tasmanian Tiger 2: Bush Rescue, will release from Early Access early next week!

At this point the price of the game will increase to $14.99USD (and equivalent prices across other currencies).
As has been our policy for our previous releases, we will not be discounting the game for any sales for at least 3 months post-exit of Early Access. This is to ensure that the people who have supported us throughout Early Access are not in any way price disadvantaged.
Lastly, the TY2 soundtrack will become available for purchase when the game leaves Early Access, and we expect to shortly thereafter set up appropriate Bundles.

Then we're going to go see The Last Jedi.

In the drive to the v1.00 release, we have also released a new build on to the EXPERIMENTAL branch!
This build has a variety of small fixes, as well as language translation updates for all languages.
Any feedback on breaking issues that would effect the full launch would be, as normal, greatly appreciated.

Thank you to everybody who has been part of this journey so far. Hopefully we'll have some more good news for you, early in 2018.

Cheers!
Lindsay

r3040_v082 Changes
ART: Up-res for textures for several actors (Clarence, Bruce, Orchid, 
Snappy, Bruno, Red, Boonie, Goannas)
AUDIO: Projectiles now play the targets hit sound if needed.
AUDIO: The thermo-bunyip trigged switches in [spoiler]Wulli Wulli Oil Rig[/spoiler] now play a sound when hit by the water from the thermo bunyip.
CONTROLS: Both analog sticks on the controller can now control the doomerang
CRASH: fix for some rendering issues that can cause driver crashes from primitive render calls.
GRAPHICS: Fixed the underwater fog effect
LOCALIZATOIN: Updated all French, German, Spanish, Italian, Swedish and Danish lines that required translations.... unless we missed any! :)
UI: Boomerang Hud - gamepad direction pointer is hidden when not using gamepad as current input.
UI: NoisyButtonGroup, ScrollingButtonGroup - play sound when changing selected item using the mouse.
UI: Pause Menu keyboard and mouse bindings - moved the "Reset to Default" and "Back" buttons upwards so they are onscreen.
UI: Updated the steam and opengl messages to refer to "TY the Tasmanian Tiger 2".
VIDEOS: Updated the videos in the extras menu of the main menu. The 2003 attract video is our original video from E3 2003, and contains footage of some of the content that didn't make the final cut. I don't believe that this video will have been seen by the general public previously. The 2004 Attract video is the video that was in the original release of the game. These are (quite obviously) lower quality than what people are used to these days; but they are the highest quality that we have!

notes.title: TY2 Build r3000_v081 has been released on EXPERIMENTAL
notes.content:
Thank you to everybody who gave us feedback on the game in the previous build that we pushed through to the DEFAULT branch.

We've made several changes, and have put up a new build on the EXPERIMENTAL branch that we'd love to get any more feedback on, before we finish up Early Access!

This build has had limited testing.

TLDR LIST OF CHANGES
Updated doomerang controls
Improved KB&M and gamepad controls; and rang selection
Fixed reverb

FULL LIST OF CHANGES
ART: Up-resed the HUD RADAR icons
ART: Tweaked the camera positions for all shops
ART: Up-res'd the background used on the loading screens.
AUDIO: Tweaks to [spoiler]Buster the Nanobot[/spoiler] sounds
AUDIO: Finally fixed the pesky issue with some sounds not properly playing unaffected by audio effects (like the opal collection sound, the health collection sound, etc)
AUDIO: Tweak to the sewer acoustic reverb settings to tone it down a little bit, and adjusted some of the sewer bubble sound effects
AUDIO: Tweak to flame thrower SFX for [spoiler]helicopter missions, Oil Rig missions, combat arena missions[/spoiler]
CAMERA: improved some of the camera code for handling turning around corners and hitting roof collision better.
CONTROLS: Adjusted mouse smoothing to improve KB&M controls
CONTROLS: Reworked the entire controller deadzone support to make the controller a bit more responsive. Should help people with issues on TY not maintaining full speed
CONTROLS: Improved the boomerang selection accuracy with gamepad
CONTROLS: Fixed bug where the exit of leaderboard screen would lock the mouse to the center of the screen on the pause menu (or while switching past it with gamepad etc).
GAMEPLAY: Fix for townies drawing (and saying their VO) when you're in the sewers
GAMEPLAY: Changed how the Doomerang controls, so that you can aim it upwards, and gives it a bit more usability for the terrain shapes throughout the game.
GRAPHICS: Fixed an issue with cloth, causing the ghosts to look terri-bad
GRAPHICS: Fixed cloth issue with selecting carts in 2 player mode
GRAPHICS: Fixed issue with terrain shadows popping on/off at various points around the level
MISC: Fix for boot up sequence to not flash the screen twice, to initialise the MSAA
MISC: Removed some various debug logs
PERFORMANCE: Fixed up packages for the game, that were causing load stalls
UI: Added pointer arrow to rang selection to help you aim at the rangs in the rang wheel
UI: Skin selection screen - user can now change the selection to un-owned skins, but can't see the name or what they look like still, and can't select them and apply to their character/vehicle. Allows easier navigation using the gamepad.

Please let us know any/all issues, ASAP!
Cheers
Linds

notes.title: Huge Bush Rescue August Update (Build r2609_v067 on DEFAULT) and TRADING CARDS Added!
notes.content:
Hi all,

There is a new build up on the DEFAULT branch for TY2; and TRADING CARDS have gone live!
This build contains some additional new items, as per the list below, as well as all the changes in the last few experimental builds, namely:
Massive kart racing handling changes
Skin support for TY and the fourbie
More achievements
Fixes to the  [spoiler]Buster the Nanobot[/spoiler] boss fight
Replayable first mission
Fixes to music and sound effect reverb problems
100s of changes to art, sounds, graphics and effects.

Note that as mentioned previously, all kart racing leaderboards, and your best times for each race have been reset as of this build, due to the changes in kart handling.

As per normal, let us know any problems.
Have fun!

Linds

New Features In This Build

AUDIO
Added missing Infrarang throw sound

CONTROLS
Fix rang direction when throwing with mouse - so it works like the TY1 throw

GAMEPLAY
Massive changes to [spoiler]Pocket Fluffy[/spoiler] boss fight. This includes [spoiler] Fluffy "taunts" TY at the beginning, then immediately jumps towards TY; Fluffy jumps directly to the pillar TY is on at the time, rather than multiple jumps along intervening pillars. Jump speed also sped up; Fluffy melee range increased; Added state to shoot at TY if he is out of melee range while Fluffy is hanging on a wall; Fewer cloud mines spawn each wave; cloud mines may now be destroyed using the bunyip power punch (AoE); Fluffy can no longer shoot "steeply" downwards - the gun turret is limited to -20 degrees of pitch (which additionally prevents clipping into the mech mesh at steep angles); Fluffy fires more quickly while hanging on a wall, and can interrupt firing to melee if TY gets in melee range; Fluffy will no longer jump to the same pillar she is currently on if all that is changing is the cling position (she'll shoot at TY instead).[/spoiler]
TY2- made the bunyips swim faster on the water surface

GRAPHICS
 Add some bunyip wake and foot splashes for the Aqua Fluffies.

MISC
Fix for filesystem crash that does a "bad MKINI" assert when loading an ini from a thread.
Fixed input issue when you have 2 joysticks connected, it could vibrate the second joystick
Fixed collectables not saving their used counts.

RACING
Disable AI DDA when iceblocked - otherwise they can still gain on you when they are behind you
Don't apply DDA to AI when they have a power boost on; so they don't go crazy-fast
Reset race "best times" in save games

UI
On the Skin Selection screen, user must press A to confirm the change to selected skin. Any other input is treated as "cancel" and the skin is reset to what was active when entering the screen.
Fixed mouse being locked to the centre of the screen on the TrophyScreen, RaceResults and LeaderboardsScreen after a race if you entered the race from in game. The mouse unlocks on the TrophyScreen and relocks after the LeaderboardsScreen if you're in game.
Added mouse support for Yes/No ControlTextBoxes.
Shifted the mission timer to the top middle area of the screen.


Previous Experimental Builds Fix Notes

ART
Updated road markings texture
Added TY and Fourbie skins, and all associated icon art
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=31mTh2t7HEI
Updated Rex and Elle textures.

AUDIO
New sounds for cart racing (bumps and hits, engine sounds, skid sounds, rolling on the road sounds, smashing in to things)
New sounds for footsteps, TY being punched, lasers, some environmental audio
New sounds for splashes
New sounds for battle bunyip attacks
New sounds and sound updates for Patchy
Fixed up some audio clipping of the fourbie engine sounds in the intro cutscene to the game
Added Kart VO system, for the racers to use for overtaking, hitting the player with a weapon, or bumping into the player
Ensured environmental effects don't play on music
Set up the trigger to stop the reverb from effecting audio when exiting the sewers in town, when completing Ranger Ken's croc mission
Stop audio effects when quitting to the main menu
Stop audio effects when on the pause menu
Fixed music cross fading so that the NEW music track fades in while the old one fades out, and adjusted fade time
Changed bilby and platinum cog to play their pickup sounds as SFX not music, to fix music reversion issue
Fixed Bilby, platinum cog and kromium orb SFX to not use environmental effects
Fix for the incorrect music playing when exiting a Birrel and Squeaver mission area (by entering the fourbie) before the mission is complete
Added new sounds to all the boomerangs they have multiple throw sounds now (impact and looping sounds)
Added "successful bite" hit sound
Fix for sounds using the Audio Fader to ignore the volume setting defined in the audio configuration file (was always playing at full volume previously). Example - TY's swimming sounds
Tweaks to chopper sounds
Changes to enemy death sounds for some enemies (croc, frill, generic enemy death)

CAMERA
Many fixes for bunyips and the camera, and pushing out of water volumes, and the camera getting stuck above you

CUSTOMIZATION

notes.title: TY2 build r2278_v044 now available on EXPERIMENTAL
notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build is up on the EXPERIMENTAL branch.
There are a LOT of new changes in this build, but there are two of particular significance that we'd love to get your feedback on.

CART RACING
Basically, we've touched a LOT of things with the cart racing.
The default controller controls are now right trigger to accelerate, left trigger to brake, A to jump/powerslide and X to fire weapons (and similar for the fourbie)
Cart handling (turning), powerslide, boost out of powerslide, jump height, acceleration and max velocity have all been tuned
Cart camera positions and FOV have been tweaked
We've added in the option to do split screen vertically as well as horizontally (currently in the camera options screen)
Cart camera smoothing for vertical "bumps" so it doesn't jitter all over the place
http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY-Race-update-June.png
The long and short of this is that the carts handle a LOT differently, and we think a lot better.
The "downside" to this is that part of us making things feel better has resulted in the overall speed being somewhat reduced - so people will more than likely not be able to beat their previous best time, or get top of the leaderboard, compared to the old code.
The plan is to get peoples' feedback on all these changes, and make adjustments.
Then, once adjustments are made we will be resetting the leaderboards for the carts, as well as resetting peoples' best times.
Feedback very much appreciated!

BOSS FIGHT CHANGES
In addition to making the boss fights replayable, we've made some changes to [spoiler]BUSTER the Nanobot[/spoiler] boss fight.
We don't want to go in to too much detail here (that's spoil it!) but in short:
[spoiler]Attack ranges reduced to make him attack more
Pauses between attacks removed to make it flow better
Added some extra "boom" to some of the attacks ;) [/spoiler]
Feedback would be awesome!

CONTROLS: Mouse boomerang aiming now works like it does in TY1 on Steam (throws at the view direction)
GRAPHICS: Added shadow normal support to improve shadow quality.MAPS: Implement "won race" icon (trophy) on the maps.
MAPS: Added star at Sgt Bluey's location in town, for the [spoiler]hidden frill mission[/spoiler]
SAVES: New save system that alows us to add new save data, moving forward.
SHOPS: Added initial lighting, shadows and SSAO to the shops.
http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY%202%20store.jpg

UI: Boomerang HUD is now toggled on and off, instead of having to hold down the "action" button (Y button on X360 controller, R key (default binding) on keyboard and mouse).
UI: You can now select  boomerangs from the Boomerang HUD, even after you upgrade them.

CONTENT UPDATES
ART: Updated the texture for the sheoak tree
AUDIO: Updated whoosh sound for main menu logo sequence
LEVELS: Changed how Sly's Shack art is loaded when you're driving around; so you can see it from a distance
LEVELS: Merged half of the different level streaming packags together, for when you're driving around. Fixes a variety of different popping issues, etc.
LEVELS: Added in "Big Croc" prop to the Southern Rivers, that didn't make the original release.
http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY%202%20Barry.jpg
LEVELS: Big props (prawn, pie, pineapple, croc) are bigger; and you can see them from further away.
LEVELS: added warp flower to near Sly's Shack - once you've made it to the top once (from this build onwards), it will appear and let you avoid having to do the jump puzzle each time you want to buy a rang.
http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY%202%20Sly%20warp.gif
LEVELS: Added some additional props around Sly's Shack
http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY%202%20Sly%20shack.jpg
LEVELS: Removed low poly houses from town, that we don't need anymore as the high-res ones are always loaded.
LEVELS: Added some additional props around the entrance to Burramudgee from the Southern Rivers

BUG FIXES and MISC
AUDIO: Rework of the audio acoustic settings system, to data drive it. Some tweaks to the various settings for the reverb etc while in caves.
AUDIO: Fix for aquarang sounds that occasionally stopped it from playing a sound.
AUDIO: Fixes to acoustic (reverb) support so that the reverb doesn't sometimes cut out, mid sound.
GRAPHICS: Fixes to draw distance calculations that caused the settings to lag by one option.
GRAPHICS: Fixed issue with shadow interpolation causing "forever shimmering" shadows.
GRAPHICS: Fixes to grass system, so grass spawning on props (like the mossy logs) works again.
GRAPHICS: Fixes for the visibility of the invisicrates and invisiplatforms (and them not being included in the shadow map).
GRAPHICS: Fix for wave height in Sheep Dip
KART RACING: Fixes to the chance for AI racers to take the shortcuts. Larger chance to take a shortcut, the further behind you they are, and reduced chance to do it, if they are close to you.
KART RACING: Simplified the rubberbanding code and made some changes so that their catch-up is less aggressive, depending on the situation.
LEADERBOARDS: Don't post a race result to the leaderboard unless it's better than the default time (10 mins).
LEADERBOARDS: Display Race times display as m:ss.cc; game completion times display as d:hh:mm:ss
MISC: Added some logging to an achievement that isn't unlocking for some users.
MEMORY: Fixes for a variety of memory leaks.
PERFORMANCE: Fixes for load-hitches as new data streams in.
UI: Removed the word "Loading" from the loading screen (TY logo with animated rings). Linds personal note - Have hated that being there since the original release, where it had to be there for TRC requirements.


WHAT'S NEXT
At the moment, the plans for next work include:
LEVELS: Continued level prop placement improvements.
PERFORMANCE: Rewrite of the grass system to improve performance.
UI: New shop UI art implementation.

As per normal; please let us know any problems, and enjoy!

Linds

notes.title: What's Coming Next?!
notes.content:
Hey all,

So - things have been a little slow the last month, as there have been a  of holidays here in Australia around Easter. But we are still making good progress on some new features, so we thought we'd share some of these with you.

BOOMERANGS: 1st pass implementation of being able to select the Tier 1 boomerangs, even after you buy the Tier 2 versions. Still need to do some polish on this for the controls before we add it to a build. Also - we've changed it so the selection overlay toggles on/off; instead of you having to hold a button
http://www.kromestudios.com/share/Rang%20Select.jpg
SAVE GAMES: Lots of "under the hood" work to allow us to add more things to the save games, so that we can implement some little bits and pieces; like a warp flower to get to the top of Sly's Spire, once you've done the jump puzzle once!
MAPS: Added a trophy icon (that was in the original game but not hooked up due to time) to show which races have been won
http://www.kromestudios.com/share/map%20icons.jpg

We're probably looking at mid-May, for the next experimental build, depending on how well the implementation control improvements for the boomerang selection and the shop UI updates goes.

This isn't a complete list of what we've done... just a few titbits to whet the appetite! :)

Any questions, let us know!

Cheers
Linds

notes.title: TY2 Builds - Information for Moving Forward
notes.content:
Hi all,

So, this game is kind of HUGE! :)

We've been thinking hard on how we want to handle updates that are up and coming, with us making changes to parts of the game that are so intricate and widespread that making any changes really does require a full retest to check out how it's used throughout the game (for example - the camera).

We've decided that we're going to change our build updates so that:
We have an additional "Experimental" Beta available for you. This will have the latest and greatest stuff, as we do it, for people to comment on; help out with issues and what not. But, people do this understanding that it may not be stable, may have unintended new issues (recent example - the helicopter camera breaking).
This branch is active and available now (though the build is currently the same as the standard build). To access it - right click on the game in your library, select properties, select the "BETAS" tab and select "experimental" from the drop down menu. You may need to reload Steam for it to be available. A picture of this is at the bottom of the post.

The standard branch on Steam will get new bulids less frequently. When we do one of these builds, they're going to go through a much more rigourous test process than the Experimental branch builds.

We're not quite certain of what the build schedule for the standard branch will be at this point - it really will depend on how the Experimental branch goes, and weighing up the time taken to test things vs implement more fixes and additions - so we'll see how we go and ease in to it.

What this does mean is that we're more likely to push updates for large-ticket items quickly, for people to check out and give us feedback on. For example:
Initial Spanish, Italian, Swedish and Danish support
Fixes for the button icon replacement throughout the UI
Changes to the level streaming so it's not as annoying running through/around town

Thanks to everybody who's help out with suggestion and bug information so far. Hopefully this will help us continue to make good progress, as well as make sure that the people who don't want to be on the bleeding edge maintain a stable experience (stable for Early Access at least!).

Happy to hear peoples' feedback.

Cheers
Linds

notes.title: TY2 Build r1931_v026 Has Been Released

notes.title: TY2 Build r1882_v023 Has Been Released
notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build of TY2 is available. The focus continues to be on improving the areas that you guys are mentioning as being things that most distract from playing the game through, as well as critical (crash) issues. Changes in this build:

BUG FIXES
ART: Activate icon on signs etc changed to match to TY1 (! icon).
ART: Changes to beach water of the overworld (Souther Rivers) to flatten water, and allow ripples.
AUDIO: Fixes for music ducking erroneously muting the audio when going in/out of pause menu, pausing during a cutscene, etc. Hopefully this resolves the majority of this problem.
CAMERA: Fix for everything going crazy when you try to lasharang rings, and you're running at low framerate.
CAMERA: Fix for an instance of the camera position occasionally getting stuck in a position.
CONTROLS: Changes to controller deadzone calculations to try to aid people having issues with "full speed run" (when holding the left stick to the maximum extent).
CONTROLS: Fix so that you control the aim of the 1st person camera with the mouse, if using keyboard and mouse, and not WASD (default binding) - more control fixes are still to come for 1st person view, but this should be a good start for people.
CONTROLS: mouse control of the mortar bunyip (for aiming) and W/S (for zooming) is now implemented.
CONTROLS: controller controls of first person now work more like what we've done for TY1 (both sticks can aim; R trigger can also throw rangs).
CONTROLS: "JUMP WITH TY" is now enabled by default when you start a new game (unless you disable it on the main menu then start a game, etc).
CRASH FIX: Fix for crash if you hit F1 in the game.
RACES: Some rework of the position calculations that assigns race positions after people have crossed the endpoint - hopefully fixing any "not in the correct place for how well you actually did" issues.
UI: Updated controller binding information images to X360 images.
UI: Copyright screen displayed for less time on boot.

NEW FEATURES
GAMEPLAY: Made the mortar bunyip fight in the first level easier (dropships have less hitpoints).
UI: You can now skip videos (eg Krome logo) with common buttons on any device (eg left mouse click).

WHAT'S NEXT (pending us not needing to jump on to more critical issues)
UI: Display appropriate icons in the cutscenes, UI, popups etc depending on your current control device.
CAMERA: Further fixes to the camera, to reimplement some of the changes we did on TY1 for Steam, into the new camera system in TY2.
CAMERA: Implement full 1st person and 3rd person invert options as per TY1.
AUDIO: Implement separate subbus for VO.
LOCALIZATION: Implement Spanish, Italian, Swedish (text only) and Danish (text only).

Any issues, please let us know. Keep in mind we're in Australia so we're knocking off from work in a few hours, but we'll be back at it in the morning :)

Cheers!
Linds
